api.title: API
api.description: Submit a row from your own code. It is the same submission the public form makes: the row is added, then the sheet's AI columns run for it.
api.loadError: The API details could not be loaded.
api.noSheet: Create a workspace to get an API endpoint.
api.fieldsNote: Send values under "fields", keyed by column name. Every field is optional, but at least one needs a value. Formula and AI columns cannot be set.
api.responseNote: A 201 response carries the saved row, the AI runs it started, and "runError" when they could not be started. The row is saved either way, so do not retry on "runError".
api.errorsNote: A 400 response names the problem in "code" (an unknown column, a value of the wrong type); 404 means the spreadsheet does not exist.
api.filesNote: File and audio columns take a public http(s) URL.
api.corsNote: Call it from a server. Browsers on other origins are blocked unless the origin is allowed by the API.
